source: FTB, 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules X and Y, https://www.ftb.ca.gov/forms/2025/2025-540-tax-rate-schedules.pdf

FTB, 2025 Personal Income Tax Booklet (Form 540): standard deduction chart, exemption credits on lines 7, 9 and 10 ($153, $153, $475), AGI Limitation Worksheet ($252,203 / $504,411, $6 per $2,500), 2025 California Tax Table (taxable income $100,000 or less), https://www.ftb.ca.gov/forms/2025/2025-540-booklet.pdf

FTB, 2026 Instructions for Form 540-ES: installments 30% / 40% / 0 / 30% due April 15, June 15, September 15 and January 15; 90% current year, 100% prior year, 110% when prior-year California AGI is over $150,000, current year only at $1,000,000 or more; the 2026 worksheet uses the 2025 tables; section B: at least $500 owed; section D: the fourth payment not needed when the return is filed by January 31, 2027, https://www.ftb.ca.gov/forms/2026/2026-540-es-instructions.pdf

FTB, 2025 Personal Income Tax Booklet, Schedule CA (540) line 29 Itemized Deductions Worksheet: reduce by the smaller of 80% of itemized deductions other than medical, investment interest and casualty losses, or 6% of federal AGI over $252,203 / $504,411; and the Behavioral Health Services Tax (1% of taxable income over $1,000,000), https://www.ftb.ca.gov/forms/2025/2025-540-booklet.pdf
